name: Change Data Capture — SQL Server → YugabyteDB via Debezium
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-client && bash .devcontainer/scripts/setup-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb.sh && echo "✅ CDC SQL Server exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb.sh && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-demo   (guided CDC SQL Server demo script)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-ws     (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → sqlserver                  (SQL Server CLI)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql                       (YugabyteDB CLI)"'

tasks.label: cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-demo
tasks.detail: "The Live Sync Pipeline" — guided SQL Server CDC demo: register connectors, snapshot, live INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb && echo '🔄 cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-demo  —  CDC pipeline demo (SQL Server → Kafka → YugabyteDB)' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual CDC commands — curl, yb-admin (init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb)
tasks.command: cd init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb && echo '🔌 cdc-sqlserver-ybdb-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual yb-admin and curl commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: sqlserver
tasks.detail: Open a SQL Server command-line client (sqlcmd) (init-cdc-sqlserver-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for SQL Server on :1433...'; until (echo >/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/1433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done; exec docker exec -it sqlserver /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P Yugabyte@123 -C
